profile.reading: K-Motion Interactive is a sports-technology company that makes 3D motion-capture and biomechanics analysis systems used in golf and baseball swing instruction, based in the Scottsdale area of Maricopa County, Arizona. The coordinates on file sit within the McDowell Mountain Business Park, a multi-tenant office and light-industrial park, and a check of the address today finds a different small business occupying that specific building. There is no indication that K-Motion, or any current tenant at this location, operates server rooms, colocation space, or dedicated data center infrastructure here. This entry describes the business as it is known publicly rather than presenting an ordinary office address as a data center facility.

reading.body:
This record cannot be read as a data center campus. The OpenStreetMap point tagged as K-Motion Interactive resolves to a sports biomechanics company offering motion-capture analytics for golf and baseball instruction, not an IT infrastructure operator. The facility publishes no data center specifications, no power allocation, and no hosting capacity. Current occupancy information suggests the site location may have changed.

Arizona has 56 mapped facilities in this registry, of which only 4 publish power specifications totaling 512 MW. This record contributes neither a megawatt figure nor a rank to that state total. Without published operator specifications, no inference about AI hosting capacity, grid demand, or compute deployment can be drawn.

This entry should be treated as a mistagged OpenStreetMap record rather than a data center asset relevant to AI infrastructure planning or grid analysis.
